public_health_question.v: What were the sources and transmission routes of a norovirus outbreak of acute gastroenteritis across five voyages of a cruise ship bound for a U.S. port?

ev.q: The investigation focused on exposure sources and routes of transmission.

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension appears; passenger vs crew status and crew job roles are exposure routes, not SES.

notes: The passenger/crew split and epidemic curve by voyage are read as a descriptive case series without denominators or computed contrasts, so data_focus is limited; a reader treating the voyage-by-voyage epi curve as a period comparison could call it yes. Laboratory norovirus genotyping only confirms cases and the 4-D spatial models are visualization, not procedures.
view_issues: The figure description is generic and gives no case counts by voyage or onset date.
